**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri che cosa sono i virus, come si riproducono nelle cellule ospiti e come si diffondono.

#### Distinguere un virus da un organismo cellulare

[distinguishAVirusFromACellularOrganism.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/virology/skills/distinguishAVirusFromACellularOrganism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare cellular organisms' cell membranes, cytoplasm, and independent metabolism with the absence of this cellular organization in a virus particle.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come i virus differiscono dagli organismi costituiti da cellule.

#### Spiegare i meccanismi di trasmissione virale

[explainMechanismsOfViralTransmission.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/virology/skills/explainMechanismsOfViralTransmission.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how viruses spread between hosts by different routes, including respiratory particles, contact, biological fluids, vectors, and other mechanisms, and why a particular route depends on the characteristics of the virus and its hosts.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta le diverse vie attraverso cui i virus possono passare da un ospite all'altro.

#### Spiegare che cos'è un virus

[explainWhatAVirusIs.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/virology/skills/explainWhatAVirusIs.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain that a virus is a noncellular infectious agent containing genetic material; it lacks its own protein-synthesis machinery and reproduces using a host cell.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega perché i virus hanno bisogno di cellule viventi per produrre altri virus.

### Zoologia

Groups: 4 · Skills: 28

[zoology.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/zoology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Comparison of major animal groups, relationships between structure and function, feeding patterns, development, and behavior. Food chains and interspecies networks as whole systems belong to Ecology.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come gli animali differiscono per struttura, movimento, crescita e comportamento.

#### Diversità degli animali

Skills: 17

[animalDiversity.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/animalDiversity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identifying major animal groups requires diagnostic characteristics, including skeletal structure, body coverings, limbs, and developmental patterns, rather than incidental external resemblance.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i principali gruppi animali attraverso caratteristiche corporee affidabili, non somiglianze superficiali.

##### Distinguere vertebrati e invertebrati

[distinguishVertebratesAndInvertebrates.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/distinguishVertebratesAndInvertebrates.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the presence of a vertebral column as the anatomical dividing line between these two broad groups.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui gli animali dotati di colonna vertebrale da quelli che ne sono privi.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche degli anfibi

[recognizeAmphibianCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeAmphibianCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify characteristic features of a group in which development is often associated with water and adults may use lungs and skin for respiration.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le caratteristiche comuni degli anfibi e del loro sviluppo.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche degli anellidi

[recognizeAnnelidCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeAnnelidCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the segmented body of annelids and distinguish them from nematodes and flatworms, even where all these animals have similarly elongated bodies.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i vermi segmentati e distinguili dagli altri animali di forma vermiforme.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche degli aracnidi

[recognizeArachnidCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeArachnidCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize arthropods with characteristic chelicerae and usually four pairs of walking legs in adults; distinguish spiders, ticks and mites, and scorpions from insects.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci ragni e altri aracnidi dalle loro caratteristiche corporee distintive.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche degli uccelli

[recognizeBirdCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeBirdCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use feathers as the primary diagnostic characteristic of birds, regardless of their ability to fly.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci gli uccelli dalle piume, anche quando non sono in grado di volare.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche degli cnidari

[recognizeCnidarianCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeCnidarianCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize cnidarians by stinging cells and the characteristic body plans of polyps and medusae; do not regard the medusa form as obligatory for every member.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci animali come meduse e coralli grazie alle loro cellule urticanti.

##### Riconoscere gli animali comuni del territorio

[recognizeCommonLocalAnimals.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeCommonLocalAnimals.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify familiar local species from a characteristic combination of body structure, coverings, and modes of movement.

**User-friendly description (it):** Identifica gli animali comuni osservando le strutture e i rivestimenti caratteristici del loro corpo.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche dei crostacei

[recognizeCrustaceanCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeCrustaceanCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize diverse crustaceans by jointed appendages, antennae, and characteristic structural traits; do not treat ten legs as a universal characteristic of crustaceans.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le diverse strutture dei crostacei senza supporre che tutti abbiano dieci zampe.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche degli echinodermi

[recognizeEchinodermCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeEchinodermCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify marine invertebrates with a water vascular system and characteristic adult symmetry, distinguishing sea stars, sea urchins, and other representatives.

**User-friendly description (it):** Identifica stelle marine e altri echinodermi attraverso le loro strutture distintive.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche dei pesci

[recognizeFishCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeFishCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify typical traits of aquatic vertebrates with gill respiration and fins while accounting for the diversity of fish.

**User-friendly description (it):** Identifica le caratteristiche tipiche dei pesci tenendo conto della loro diversità.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche dei platelminti

[recognizeFlatwormCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeFlatwormCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the flattened body and other features of flatworms, including free-living and parasitic forms, without confusing them with annelids.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i vermi piatti e distinguili dai vermi segmentati.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche degli insetti

[recognizeInsectCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeInsectCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify six legs, three main body regions, and other characteristic features of adult insects.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci gli insetti dalle sei zampe e dalle tre regioni principali del corpo.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche dei mammiferi

[recognizeMammalCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeMammalCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify members by mammary glands and characteristic body coverings without assuming that every mammal gives birth to live young.

**User-friendly description (it):** Identifica i mammiferi attraverso i loro caratteri distintivi senza supporre che tutti partoriscano piccoli vivi.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche dei molluschi

[recognizeMolluscCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeMolluscCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the soft body, mantle, and other characteristic features of gastropods, bivalves, and cephalopods, taking into account that not all molluscs have an external shell.

**User-friendly description (it):** Identifica i molluschi attraverso il loro corpo molle e le altre strutture caratteristiche.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche dei nematodi

[recognizeNematodeCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeNematodeCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the unsegmented elongated bodies of roundworms and features of their lifestyles, including free-living and parasitic forms.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i vermi cilindrici dal corpo non segmentato e da altre caratteristiche.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche dei rettili

[recognizeReptileCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeReptileCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify members by characteristics of scaled skin and reproductive features of terrestrial amniotes.

**User-friendly description (it):** Identifica le caratteristiche dei rettili, comprese quelle della pelle e della riproduzione.

##### Riconoscere le caratteristiche delle spugne

[recognizeSpongeCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/skills/recognizeSpongeCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the porous body structure and filter-feeding of sponges, explaining that they lack true tissues and organs.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le spugne dal corpo poroso e dall'alimentazione per filtrazione.

#### Comportamento

Skills: 3

[behavior.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/behavior/behavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Animal actions arise in response to signals and needs; observation makes it possible to identify defense, communication, and benefits of living in groups.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come il comportamento degli animali favorisce comunicazione, protezione e vita di gruppo.

##### Spiegare i vantaggi del comportamento di gruppo

[explainBenefitsOfGroupBehavior.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/behavior/skills/explainBenefitsOfGroupBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how cooperative foraging, defense, or care for offspring may improve the success of individuals.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come la vita di gruppo può aiutare gli animali a nutrirsi, difendersi e prendersi cura dei piccoli.

##### Spiegare il ruolo dei segnali nella comunicazione animale

[explainTheRoleOfSignalsInAnimalCommunication.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/behavior/skills/explainTheRoleOfSignalsInAnimalCommunication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sound, smell, movement, or coloration to information received by another individual.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega come gli animali comunicano attraverso suoni, movimenti e altri segnali.

##### Riconoscere i comportamenti difensivi

[recognizeDefensiveBehavior.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/behavior/skills/recognizeDefensiveBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether fleeing, freezing, distraction, or attacking reduces a threat in a given situation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i comportamenti che gli animali adottano quando si sentono minacciati.

#### Nutrizione e sviluppo

Skills: 4

[nutritionAndDevelopment.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/nutritionAndDevelopment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Food sources differ among animal groups, while their life cycles may involve body transformations or development without a drastic change in form.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come variano l'alimentazione e i cicli vitali degli animali.

##### Classificare gli animali in base alla dieta

[classifyAnimalsByDiet.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/skills/classifyAnimalsByDiet.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify examples as herbivores, carnivores, or omnivores according to actual diets rather than animal names.

**User-friendly description (it):** Classifica gli animali in base a ciò di cui si nutrono effettivamente.

##### Confrontare lo sviluppo con e senza metamorfosi

[compareDevelopmentWithAndWithoutMetamorphosis.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/skills/compareDevelopmentWithAndWithoutMetamorphosis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare life cycles involving radical structural change with cycles in which young individuals resemble adults.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta gli animali che cambiano forma durante lo sviluppo con quelli che non lo fanno.

##### Distinguere animali giovani e adulti

[distinguishJuvenilesAndAdults.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/skills/distinguishJuvenilesAndAdults.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine an individual’s developmental stage by body proportions, coverings, or reproductive maturity.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le differenze tra animali giovani e adulti.

##### Spiegare la metamorfosi completa negli insetti

[explainCompleteMetamorphosisInInsects.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/skills/explainCompleteMetamorphosisInInsects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the four developmental stages of insects with complete metamorphosis: egg, larva, pupa, and imago; using butterflies, beetles, or flies as examples, distinguish the markedly different functions and structures of larvae and adults.

**User-friendly description (it):** Segui le fasi di uovo, larva, pupa e adulto nella metamorfosi completa degli insetti.

#### Struttura e funzioni

Skills: 4

[structureAndFunctions.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/structureAndFunctions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The forms of limbs, body coverings, and sensory structures are explained by their roles in locomotion, orientation, and protection against danger.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come le strutture degli animali li aiutano a muoversi, percepire l'ambiente e proteggersi.

##### Spiegare il ruolo degli organi di senso nel comportamento

[explainTheRoleOfSensoryOrgansInBehavior.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/skills/explainTheRoleOfSensoryOrgansInBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect perception of sounds, smells, light, or vibrations with orientation and finding food.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come gli organi di senso aiutano gli animali a trovare cibo e a orientarsi.

##### Individuare gli adattamenti protettivi negli animali

[identifyProtectiveAdaptationsInAnimals.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/skills/identifyProtectiveAdaptationsInAnimals.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the function of camouflage, shells or armor, spines, and other defensive structures in particular situations.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le strutture che aiutano gli animali a difendersi.

##### Collegare i rivestimenti corporei alle loro funzioni

[relateBodyCoveringsToTheirFunctions.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/skills/relateBodyCoveringsToTheirFunctions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how feathers, fur, scales, and skin provide protection, thermal insulation, or water balance.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega come pelliccia, piume, squame e pelle proteggono il corpo degli animali.

##### Collegare la struttura degli arti alla locomozione

[relateLimbStructureToLocomotion.data.ts](../../../content/biology/data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/skills/relateLimbStructureToLocomotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the shape of legs, fins, or wings to the requirements of walking, swimming, digging, or flying.

**User-friendly description (it):** Collega le forme degli arti al cammino, al nuoto, allo scavo o al volo.
